rationale: Consumes the SVG stroke style the vector lowering already records (svg_stroke_linecap / _linejoin / _miterlimit) in the native materializer and the baked C++ codegen, through one shared parser, and collects stroke-linecap, stroke-linejoin, stroke-miterlimit and stroke-dashoffset as computed style so a stylesheet-set cap reaches the existing lowering. Additive paint state on SvgPathWidget; Chromium stays the only oracle and Skia/Dawn the renderer, so no design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
